title: AOP-Wiki multi-version RDF endpoint (data pipeline)
description: Pipeline that builds a versioned RDF representation of the AOP-Wiki: it downloads every quarterly AOP-Wiki XML release (aopwiki.org/downloads), converts each to RDF/Turtle, validates it, and loads it into a single Virtuoso SPARQL endpoint as one named graph per release (http://aopwiki.org/graph/YYYY-MM-DD). Live endpoint: aopwiki-multirdf.vhp4safety.nl/sparql. The conversion method is described in doi.org/10.1089/aivt.2021.0010; the generated dataset is archived at 10.5281/zenodo.13353286.
